title: How to Contact Facebook Support (and Get A Human Being)
description: In this video I show you how to contact Facebook Support and get an actual human being. Please note that what you see on your screen may vary depending on whether or not you are an advertiser, or based on the nature of your query.    To learn more go to http://musicmarketingmanifesto.com and download your free copy of the Music Marketing Blueprint.
